notes.title: The Winter Update is out of experimental
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210437/65366b6f60d7553238153ba15220a720acf52879.png[/img]

The Winter Update for I Fought the Lawn has been moved out of experimental.

We hope you enjoy the new areas and machines. We're still making improvements, but feel the update is stable enough for general release. Like always, please let us know if you experience any oddities.

Our deepest thanks again to everyone who has helped make the first month of our first Steam game both exciting and challenging. There is a lot more to come over the next few months, so stay tuned!

notes.title: The Winter Update - Patch 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210437/65366b6f60d7553238153ba15220a720acf52879.png[/img]

The first patch for The Winter Update is in experimental and addresses the following items:

[list]
[*]ESC Key does not close key remapper
[*]World theme particles not getting unloaded on reset
[*]UI getting cut off in 21:9 format
[*]Mower sound it travelling too far
[*]Confirmation dialog on sell button
[*]Starting job while client is in garage menu prevents client movement when job starts
[*]Pausing after hitting bomb prevents knockback
[*]Job selection menu options need to update when connected clients change equipment or a new player connects
[/list]

notes.title: The Winter Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210437/65366b6f60d7553238153ba15220a720acf52879.png[/img]

We are very happy to announce our first content update for I Fought the Lawn is now out on experimental! You can try it out today by switching to experimental in the Betas panel.

The main focus of this first update is the addition of Snow Blowers to the equipment store, but we've added a few additional things.

[list]
[*] While it still needs visual work, a functional key remapper is now in place
[*] The backyard has been expanded, and doors opened, allowing exploration at home base
[*] There is now a practice area outside the garage in the far back of the yard
[*] Players can now access the computer from anywhere in the home base area by pressing spacebar
[*] Multiplayer - Hazard triggers are now synced across connected clients
[*] Multiplayer - Players will no longer be able to be left behind in the garage if a job is taken before they've equipped a machine
[*] Multiplayer - Players must equip the same type of machine as the host in order to take a job
[*] Job types depend on type of equipment currently in use. Mowers will show grass type jobs. Snow Blowers will show winter levels.
[*] Various stability and performance improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Launch week 2 - Multiplayer and QoL updates
notes.content:
- Minimap grass markers are now much darker. Should be easier to distinguish from ground color.
- Player starting locations have been moved closer to the computer for both single and multiplayer
- Spacebar now activates computer from anywhere in the garage area
- Home base garage doors have been opened. Feel free to cruise around the backyard to try now newly purchased machines.
- New title screen music
- Small UX update to indicate computer importance
- Removed jitter in hidden player/machine shader
- Hazard triggers are now synced across multiplayer sessions

notes.title: Launch week day 4 patch notes
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has been patient as we work through these bugs. Today's first patch includes includes a larger effort fix, as well as some quality of life fixes and rebalancing.

[list]
[*]Individual machine stats are now being applied to overall performance.
[*]Performance improvements in level generation
[*]Initial confirmation feedback for code copy function using clipboard icon
[*]Machine sounds are now partially based on player speed
[*]Player now uses acceleration for ramping up to top speed
[*]Machine speed rebalancing
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplayer - Critical update
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone for your patience over the last two days. While there are still a number of bugs left, they have been decreasing at a steady pace. Today's update represents a major fix to multiplayer functionality.

Notes:
[list]
[*]Multiplayer - Hosts will no longer have to restart their game after client disconnect
[*]Multiplayer - Clients can now disconnect and reconnect to a session
[*]Multiplayer - Clients will no longer be stuck in limbo after host disconnects
[/list]

notes.title: Day 1 patch notes - Round 1
notes.content:
We are working to fix the initial bug reports we have received. This patch represents the first of several to come over this coming week.

Release notes are as follows:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that would put the Friend List into an infinite loop
[*]Players can no longer explode themselves onto the ocean surface and walk off the map edge
[*]Multiplayer - Fixed an issue that was preventing the connected player count from resetting on game
[*]Multiplayer - Fixed an issue that was preventing the connected player count from reducing when a player disconnected
[/list]
